Name: Anthro Aliyah
Author: Emreld3000
Description:
This is a Portraits and Sprites mod for Aliyah so that she fits in with the characters from Anthro Characters Continued!

BetasEnjoyer11 originally created a portrait art for Sam's genderswap from ACC, which never got used. I've repurposed that portrait for use with Aliyahto make her ACC-compatible. With Yuninocorn's and BetasEnjoyer11's permission, I adapted Aliyah's s clothing and hair and crafted sprites for her using Sam/Samantha's sprites.

This is a standard Content Patcher mod. Install it like you would any other. 

This mod features Aliyah's Standard, Fall Outdoors, Winter, Winter Indoors, and Island appearences, and also changes the close-up shot from Aliyah's 4-heart event to make it more "furry".

This is the fourth in a series of portraits and sprites projects. Previous projects in this series were for other fan NPCs: Quinn, Lance/Lannah, Victor/Victoria. I encourage you to check them out. This marks the past-halfway point of this series of projects of mine. I expect perhaps three more projects like this out of me.
